preregistered_criteria.question: does TA_BUSY in Render Color follow the count of pixel-stage texture instructions, as O5 concluded, or not
preregistered_criteria.lever: number of lights surviving tile culling, set in C++ data only. The pixel shader bytecode must stay 52CE6C5E64AB2E82 in every variant and the build gate enforces it, so instruction selection, register pressure and scheduling are fixed by construction.
preregistered_criteria.dose: SQ_PS INSTS_TEX_LOAD per pixel-shader wave, measured, never inferred from the stride. Culling by radius is not assumed to be perfect - whatever it actually removes is what the dose reports.
preregistered_criteria.confounder: SQ_PS INSTS_VALU and INST_CYCLES_VALU fall as well, since each removed light removes its shading arithmetic. Measured in the same single-pass session as the dose and reported beside it. This cycle cannot separate the two by itself; O4 already separated them in the other direction (TA_BUSY -3.5 % at fixed ALU).
preregistered_criteria.response_mechanistic: sum of TA_PERF_SEL_TA_BUSY over the 80 CUs (set tcp_ta, 1 pass)
preregistered_criteria.response_outcome: GPUTime and GPUBusyCycles of the Render Color sample (set resp)
preregistered_criteria.replication_band: the model predicts d TA_BUSY / d (PS texture instructions) in [0.75, 1.25] on every arm, and an implied marginal cost per removed instruction in [10, 19] cycles, i.e. 14.5 +- 30 %. Bands fixed before measuring.
preregistered_criteria.falsification: a ratio below 0.5 on the arms falsifies O5's conclusion: TA_BUSY would not be following the instruction count. Above 1.5 the model is incomplete - something else scales with the lights as well.
preregistered_criteria.statistic: median over >= 32 samples per run, 3 independent processes per variant, order interleaved and reversed; threshold max(2 %, 3 x N95) per metric from the L128 A/A control measured here, as in O4
